subject: TGP2 import copies manifest as ISA: use parsed code_offset, test actual imported BO
body: New concrete package integration blocker: nord2_metal_bridge.c import_pipeline lines167-168 copies info.code_bytes starting at TEGU_PIPELINE2_HEADER_BYTES (128) for every v2 package. The revised parser places 64-byte manifest records at128 and exposes info2.code_offset=128+64*manifest_count. With any resource manifest, imported executable BO therefore starts with manifest bytes and truncates real ISA. Fix v2 copy to parsed info2.code_offset (TGP1 stays header64); producer test must inspect allocated code BO contents after actual method5 import, not only method7 packets. Use nonzero manifest records with distinctive sentinels and 16+bytes of known code so exact-byte-copy is observable. Also require source hashes for the parser and bridge together. This is independent of shader-program descriptor initialization. No build/edit by audit.
